get_rotation_matrix: compute a 2D rotation matrix from viewer position and viewer look tensors for voxel coordinate rotation
get_xyz_viewer_look_coords_batched: transform batched target coordinates into a viewer-centric rotated coordinate system using viewer position and look vectors
get_dir_dist: compute the direction and distance from a viewer position and look point to batched target coordinates
dim_dir_to_dir_tensor: convert a 3D dimension index and direction sign into a 5-element direction vector tensor
get_rotated_context_to_seg_origin: compute the target segment origin coordinates relative to a context box based on viewer position and direction vector
